correctness.rationale: All-size proof: exactly defined 256-state and 16-state de Bruijn transfer graphs give \(\operatorname{tr}(T^n)=\#\operatorname{Fix}(F^2)\) and \(\operatorname{tr}(S^n)=\#\operatorname{Fix}(F)\); exact reconstructed integer characteristic polynomials of every cyclic strongly connected component yield Lucas and six-residue formulas. Standard-library verifier builds graph edges and computes exact characteristic coefficients; separately coded vertex evolution exhausts \(3\le n\le10\) (1,398,080 labelled configurations in total), agreeing with both formulas. The asymptotic is from a unique dominant root \(\phi^2\); no finite sample is substituted for the transfer argument.

value.rationale: A genuinely motivated graph-family invariant: the exact period-two orbit census under open-neighborhood majority on a natural infinite cubic vertex-transitive prism family. It refines the generic period-two theorem, yields a nontrivial Lucas-residue-six classification and exponential 2-cycle growth, and distinguishes a two-layer cubic rule from single-ring dynamics. Exact orbit counts are relevant to stationary/oscillatory phase classifications despite no basin statistics being asserted.
